name: Triangle Tyre Co.,Ltd
summary: Triangle Tyre Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, and marketing of tire products in China and internationally. The company offers commercial vehicle tires, passenger car tires, engineering tires, giant tires, and special vehicle tires to the automobile manufacturers, construction machinery plants, end consumers, mines, engineering projects, and corporate clients. It also provides bridge carriers, as well as truck and bus, industrial, construction and gant mining, and radial tires.
